description: The contrast to manifest-loads-language-entirely-absent: the de file is again unrecognized, but de-CH loads. German therefore has exactly one loaded locale and DefaultStrings synthesizes the identity tiebreaker de:[de-CH] (DefaultStrings.java: 'If there is exactly 1 locale for the language code, it's its own identity tiebreaker'), which visibly changes the attempted-locale chain for de and de-AT requests. de-CH is chosen over de-AT deliberately so the loaded child is NOT the likely-subtag expansion of the requests, isolating the tiebreaker route.
